# No loot boxes; fixed, previewed rewards

Status: accepted. Date: set in the original game design (before the 20 Nov 2026 redesign; reaffirmed in `docs/game-economy.md`). Source: `docs/game-design.md` sections 4 and 6, `docs/game-design-review.md`.

**Context.** The product is for a child. Chance rewards, money, streak pressure and comparison with others are common retention tools and are harmful in a children's learning product.

**Decision.** There is no randomness and no loot box, not even with disclosed odds. Every (sub-topic, tier) maps to one card, generated by a seeded script and shown before the quiz. No payments, no leaderboards or comparing children, no shaming copy ("Not yet", never "fail"), no notifications or limited-time events. Losing a streak removes nothing the child owns. The day ends at a parent-set cap.

**Consequences.** Rewards come from a build script (`build_rewards.py`), not from play-time logic. Any economy change (such as a coin shop) must keep fixed prices and a child-chosen card.
